personas.name: SaaS Founder / CEO
personas.description: Founder or CEO of a B2B SaaS company with $5M+ ARR exploring non-dilutive financing to extend runway without giving up equity. Researching venture debt vs. raising another round, comparing lenders on speed, terms, and warrants.

personas.name: Startup CFO / VP Finance
personas.description: Finance leader at a growth-stage tech company evaluating debt structures — unitranche, second lien, revolving lines. Comparing cost of capital, covenants, amortization schedules, and term lengths across venture debt providers.

personas.name: Canadian Investor (Private Credit)
personas.description: Canadian institutional or retail investor researching venture debt funds, private credit, or alternative fixed income for portfolio diversification. Evaluating fund performance, yield, risk profile, and track record of fund managers.

personas.name: VC / Board Advisor
personas.description: Venture capital investor or board member advising a portfolio company on financing strategy. Researching which venture debt lenders are founder-friendly, fast to close, and fair on terms to recommend to their founders.

personas.name: Healthcare / Vertical SaaS Operator
personas.description: Operator in healthcare tech or vertical SaaS — Espresso's most profitable lending verticals — researching growth financing options specific to their industry. May be less familiar with venture debt as a concept.
